title: DOE EM infrastructure: Hanford's facility and maintenance denominator
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named U.S. agencies
summary: GAO reports that Hanford had 1,547 facilities as of June 2025, including 322 mission-critical facilities; five mission-critical facilities had poor or very poor condition indexes and five were rated inadequate. Operating facilities had $230.2 million in annual actual maintenance, $318.3 million in annual required maintenance, $100.6 million in deferred maintenance, and $466.6 million in repair needs. Denominator: Hanford facilities and operating-or-standby maintenance measures as of June 2025.

Boundary: The four maintenance measures have distinct definitions and must not be summed as one backlog.
Boundary: Facility counts and condition ratings do not measure cleanup outcomes.
Boundary: GAO identified broader data-quality and comparability weaknesses across EM sites.
